item.title: Running Dagger on an ephemerd Runner Fleet
item.description:
A friend asked me if Dagger replaces ephemerd. It doesn’t. They sit at different layers. Since I just rode this merry-go-round here is how I put the two together, with every command run against a real engine on a Linux box.

Two layers, not two competitors

Dagger is a client plus an engine. The engine is a long-running daemon that wraps BuildKit. Every step in a pipeline runs as a container under runc inside that engine. The client is the dagger CLI or an SDK. It sends the pipeline to the engine and prints the result.
